note: Somalia had no functioning central government on 1 January 2000, so most 'laws' describe the de facto situation rather than enacted legislation. Economy: no central bank, regulator or tax authority, hence laissez_faire. Trade: there was no national customs service; faction-controlled ports and airstrips levied their own fees, modelled as free_trade. Conscription: there was no national army, only clan militias, hence volunteer_force. Press: private newspapers and radio stations operated without a national regulator but under pressure from armed factions, modelled as regulated_press. Religion: local Islamic (sharia) courts handled justice in parts of Mogadishu and elsewhere, hence religious_law_partial. Immigration: no functioning border control, hence open_immigration. Internet: privately run telecoms and no state regulator, hence open_internet. These are gameplay approximations.
